metadata.description: Live-captured POST /api/mdm/profiles/platforms/linux/create against UEM 26.2.0.0 (host <internal-env>), 2026-08-10, the recapture epic's Workstream C. This route is absent from the vendored upstream swagger (no internal-source/*.json declares it, including all 4 mdm versions) despite being live and functional; internal-source/mdmv4.overlay.yaml gap-fills it, so internal-source/mdmv4.json declares /profiles/platforms/linux/create. Capture proceeded directly against the endpoint per doctrine (linux profiles use API v4 at /api/mdm/profiles/linux/, per CLAUDE.md quirk #3/api-doctrine.md quirk 3). General.ProfileScope required an integer (1) despite swagger declaring it type:string -- same root-cause pattern as api-doctrine.md quirks 9/11/12/13 (swagger-declared type does not match wire reality); ProfileScope=0 or omitted fails with 'ProfileScope cannot be null'. Top-level payload key is WifiList->Wifis (plural, per LinuxDeviceProfileEntity1 schema), not the appleosx-style singular payload name. Response is a bare int (created ProfileId), consistent with apple/appleosx/winrt create shape. Real captured id hand-replaced with 12346 for anonymization (mock-capture's anonymizer does not touch top-level scalar bodies).
